parole.testo: Inherited from Middle Russian сигъ (sig) attested in 1496, borrowed from Old Novgorodian сиге (sige). Ultimately from Proto-Finnic *siika, of unknown further origin. Compare also Swedish sik, Norwegian Nynorsk sik and Latvian sīga.
From a finnic language, ultimately from Proto-Finnic *huudëh. Compare Finnish huude, Veps hudeg, Ludian huudeh
